environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No WAF, no reverse proxy with origin validation. Service binds directly to port 8080, NLB forwards TCP connections transparently. DNS is managed via Route53 with a public A record pointing to the NLB. No rate limiting configured at any layer. The service is accessible from the public internet on port 443 (TLS terminated at NLB).

config.dns: Route53 public hosted zone, A record to NLB
config.network: public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
config.tls: terminated at NLB with ACM certificate
